name: Sam Rivera
goal: Book a cleaning on Wednesday morning

name: Dana Whitfield
goal: Book any appointment as fast as possible before a flight
quirk: Short, clipped replies. Gets annoyed at questions and says things like 'just pick one'.

name: Harold Pierce
goal: Book a checkup for his wife and himself
quirk: Rambles, mixes up days and times, and asks the receptionist to repeat things.

name: Priya Nair
quirk: Insists on a slot that doesn't exist (Monday 9am) and pushes back when told it's unavailable.

name: Marcus Lee
goal: Find out how much a root canal costs before deciding to book
quirk: Asks about prices, insurance, and which dentist he will see. Tests whether the bot makes things up.

name: Tina Alvarez
goal: Book Friday at 2pm for her son's first dental visit
quirk: Nervous about the visit. Asks lots of worried questions before committing.

name: Greg Novak
goal: Book Tuesday at 3pm, then change his mind and switch to Wednesday
quirk: Picks a slot, confirms it, then reverses and asks to change it.

name: Jules Carter
goal: Get a weekend appointment, or tell the bot his dental emergency is urgent
quirk: Has a toothache and asks for same-day or Saturday care. Goes off topic and describes symptoms.
